title: French Mushroom Terrine
description: A rich and earthy French dish made with sautéed mushrooms and served as a terrine.
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil until tender.
Butter the terrine mold and arrange the bread slices in the bottom.
Add the sautéed mushrooms on top of the bread.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle with shattering and cover with the remaining bread slices.
Transfer the terrine to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool before serving.
